jp.title: 東京34日続く長雨いつまで? 10月は日差し戻る この先は晴れる日増加へ
jp.description: 東京都心では今日29日で34日連続の降水となり、過去最長を更新しました。明日30日から10月1日にかけても関東は曇りや雨となりますが、長く続いたぐずついた天気にもようやく出口が見えてきました。10月2日以降は東京でも日差しが戻り、この先は全国的に晴れる日が増える見込みです。一方、天気の回復とともに昼間の気温が上がる日もあり、一日の寒暖差に注意が必要です。

world.title: Kither Biotech Initiates Dosing of Patients in Phase 1b / 2a Study of KIT2014 in COPD
world.description: KIT2014 is a novel inhaled peptide therapy being developed for respiratory diseases including chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD), non-CF bronchiectasis (NCFB), idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF) and cystic fibrosis (CF)The first patients have now been dosed in Kither’s randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled, dose-ranging Phase 1b / 2a trial in adults with moderate to severe COPDThe Australia-based multicentre study will evaluate the safety, tolerability and pharmacokinetics of KIT2014, plus early signs of efficacyKIT2014’s unique and proprietary mode of action, involving balanced dual PDE3/4 inhibition, acts to improve respiratory symptoms by enhancing bronchodilation and reducing lung inflammation TURIN, Italy, Sept. 29, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Kither Biotech Pty Ltd and Kither Biotech Srl, a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical group of companies developing innovative therapies for respiratory diseases, today announced that it has dosed the first patients in its Phase 1b / 2a clinical study of KIT2014 in adults with moderate to severe COPD.
